description: This circular walk explores the countryside surrounding the delightful Oxfordshire villages of North Leigh and Ramsden. On the way will also pass the Holly Grove Woods and Wilcote. Starting at North Leigh you first head north west to visit neighbouring Ramsden. There's some lovely views of the green fields as you make your way along North Leigh Lane. In Ramsden you could stop off and enjoy some refreshments at The Royal Oak. The historic 17th century inn serves quality food and also provides rooms. After exploring Ramsden you return to North Leigh via Wilcote and Bridewell Farm. You can continue your walking by heading east to visit the North Leigh Roman Ruins. See the video for more details on this ancient site. Head north to explore the area around Finstock and Charlbury on the Charlbury to Finstock Circular Walk .
